quote: We carried out a human survey to compare the ease of understanding and the utility of the explanations obtained by LIME and LENs. The human survey was approved by the ethics committee and the questions do not record personal information. The survey was shared with students and researchers over different universities and filled by 26 respondents, 13 with experience in Machine Learning, 10 in Computer Science and 3 in neither.
We carried out a human survey to compare the ease of understanding and the utility of the explanations obtained by LIME and LENs.
guideline: Survey tasks included: rating ease of understanding local explanations; identifying a feature to ignore to improve the classifier; identifying the more general classifier; and rating ease of using explanations for specific purposes.

The survey presents respondents with a sample input, prediction, and explanations from LIME and LEN p , and asks them to rate ease of understanding, identify features to ignore to improve the classifier, identify the more general classifier, and rate ease of use for these tasks.
criteria: ability to identify feature to ignore
ability to identify more general classifier
